t: An Arduino robot arm kit that stores and repeats up to 100 movements.
steps: Find the HamiltonBuhl 4-Axis STEAM Robo-Arm Kit at a retailer such as Wellbots or Adorama.
Ask IT to install the Arduino IDE or Rollarm software on a Windows PC.
Assemble the arm with the included screwdriver.
Control the arm by hand with the potentiometers.
